analysis.hypothesis: The model requires three custom CUDA operations: view_as_real for complex64, log_softmax over last dimension (size 2), and group normalization without affine parameters. Each can be implemented with efficient kernels. The first two operations are elementwise/independent over the last dimension; group norm involves reductions per sample and group. Since the input is contiguous and the output shape is [512,8,128,128,2], a single fused kernel may not be necessary but separate kernels per operation are straightforward. The binding layer will allocate outputs and call launchers. We implement launchers with stable C interfaces: view_as_real_complex64_launcher, log_softmax_dim_last_launcher, group_norm_fp32_launcher. All kernels handle the contracted shapes and dtypes exactly.

Contract specifies input complex64 [512,8,128,128] contiguous, output float32 [512,8,128,128,2] contiguous with stride [262144,32768,256,2,1].
